old: TechCrunch and Al Jazeera both present the resignation as a consequence of that affair; Nvidia itself has not said so.[^3][^4]
new: TechCrunch reports that the resignation came "just a few days after" Huang admitted the affair, and Al Jazeera that he stepped down "following espionage and affair allegations"; Nvidia itself has not linked the two.[^3][^4]
why: The two outlets report the resignation as coming after the affair and the allegations; neither says it was their consequence. The line now quotes their own words.
